name: What is the typical process for ordering and installing custom molding?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for ordering and installing custom molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your design vision, material preferences, and budget. Next, precise measurements of the space are taken, and detailed drawings or prototypes of the molding profiles are created for your approval. Once approved, the custom molding is fabricated, often by a specialized millwork shop. Finally, our team handles the professional installation, including precise cutting, fitting, and finishing to ensure a seamless and high-quality result that matches your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The custom molding process involves consultation, precise measurements, design approval, fabrication by a millwork shop, and professional installation by our team.
